name: Gorlois

attributes.attribute: already dead when Igraine conceived Arthur

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gorlois was the duke of Cornwall in Arthurian legend. He married Igraine, a woman famed across Wales for her beauty. She bore his daughters, including the magical Morgan and the doomed Morgause. King Uther Pendragon desired her, but Igraine stayed faithful to her husband. Uther then used the magician Merlin to appear in Gorlois's body, and Igraine conceived Arthur without knowing that Gorlois was already dead by Uther's hand. That child grew to be Arthur, the fabled king of Britain.

okr.objective: Present Gorlois as the duke of Cornwall whose body Uther used to beget Arthur.
key_results: Gorlois ruled as duke of Cornwall.
Igraine bore his daughters Morgan and Morgause.
Merlin reshaped Uther into the form of the dead Gorlois.
Igraine conceived Arthur unaware that Gorlois had died.
